.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/task/environment/assets/kittle.json (clock, accounts, matters, walls, timers, holds; byte-identical to solution/app/seed/kittle.json)
evidence: Frozen brief files match manifest hashes (instruction.md 3ccf6623..., conversations.md 910855ab..., integration.md e00af473..., walls-and-retention.md 23d6e45b...). Spelling: extracted all 531 distinct word tokens from instruction.md plus the three notes and read them; no misspellings (proper nouns Kittle, Rowe, Anand, Lloyd, Pryce, Marsh and technical tokens better-sqlite3, NODE_PATH, DB_PATH are correct); no doubled words; all four files are pure ASCII, LF line endings, no BOM; no US/UK spelling mix (no colour/behaviour-type words occur). The only misspelling in the task inputs is the seed's intentional prior version of K-2 ('Landlords notice recieved.' in environment/assets/kittle.json), which is edit-history data, not brief text. Contamination: grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|<tag>|C:\|/home/|/Users/|/mnt/|F:/|lorem|NOTE:|?? found only the product word 'placeholder' (conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:35, meaning the deleted-message placeholder) and 'author(s)' as product role. Template CHANGE_ME lines (template instruction.md:1, notes.md) are fully replaced; template notes.md is not shipped. No author asides, duplicated paragraphs, grader terms or foreign-machine paths; all paths are container paths (/assets/kittle.json, /instructions, /app/server.js, /app/app.db) that agree with environment/Dockerfile:14-15. Internal consistency: single clock (integration.md:7 '2026-05-12T11:00:00Z' == seed 'clock'); single seed path (instruction.md:5 and integration.md:5 both /assets/kittle.json); single account list (walls-and-retention.md:5-11 matches the five seed accounts, names and roles); 'Dev Anand is walled from M-12' (walls-and-retention.md:15) matches seed M-12 walled ['dev@kittle.test']; timer choices off/1/7/30 (walls-and-retention.md:23) match seed timer_options_days [null,1,7,30]; the 'exactly seven days ago is already gone' boundary agrees with seed K-10 (2026-05-05T11:00:00Z on 7-day M-11) and K-11 (+1s); delete-vs-hold rules agree (conversations.md:9 'unless a partner has put them on hold' vs walls-and-retention.md:29 'Nobody, including its author, can delete a held message'); deleted-with-replies placeholder rule is stated consistently in conversations.md:9, walls-and-retention.md:25 and :35; the brief's description of /instructions (instruction.md:5) matches the three shipped note files. One tension checked and judged not a contradiction: conversations.md:9 says 'our staff can open its earlier versions' while walls-and-retention.md:35 says a transcript (openable by anyone who can see the matter, including the client) 'For a held message that was edited, ... shows each version'. These are distinct surfaces with distinct rules (thread version viewer vs transcript record for held messages), so both can be satisfied simultaneously; it is at most a fairness/ambiguity question for row 6, not contamination. Adversarial framing: a pasted-in TODO, second clock, or stray path would mislead a builder into a wrong product; none exists, so no conforming app is misled and no broken app gains anything from this row. Deterministic counterparts (check-instruction-content.py, check-instruction-hygiene.py) were not run by me; this verdict rests on manual text review only.
